theme: bold retro cartoon authority humor - multi-breed collection brand extension
slogan: HEAD OF SECURITY / Zero Tolerance for Squirrels

slogan_validation.format_category: authority/role humor (identity 17% + humor 33% hybrid in dachshund market structure)
slogan_validation.format_category_evidence: Identity-role family (Dachshund Dad Club BSR 267K, Floral Doxie Mama 396K) + humor (33% of niche) -- this hybrid is load-bearing across both
slogan_validation.cross_niche_template_check: primary 'HEAD OF SECURITY' is template; secondary 'Zero Tolerance for Squirrels' anchors to dachshund via canonical breed prey (squirrels) -- parallels the chicken/foxes mapping that worked in chicken-keeper
slogan_validation.mirror_or_invent: hybrid (mirror our own chicken Head of Security format + invent dachshund-specific squirrel anchor)
slogan_validation.mirror_reasoning: The Head of Security badge format is data-validated by us in chicken-keeper. Extending it to dachshund builds a multi-breed collection brand (the suggestion from external feedback), not a one-off design. Untapped in dachshund-specific CSV (0 hits for security/patrol/watch in this data) so we are filling a gap, not crowding a saturated lane.

design_feedback_disposition.extend_head_of_security_framework: APPLIED -- the strongest single suggestion in the research-director feedback; builds collection brand across niches
